name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 4.2V — WSON
description: Surface-mount 4.2V low-dropout (LDO) linear regulator IC cluster in a WSON package family featuring the WSON-6_1.5x1.5mm_P0.5mm footprint.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a 4.2V low-dropout linear regulator in an SMD package.
Verify compatibility with the WSON-6 1.5x1.5mm 0.5mm pitch footprint.
Confirm part specifications using representative part TLV70242PDSE.
avoid_when: The circuit requires an output voltage other than 4.2V.
The PCB design requires through-hole mounting or non-WSON package footprints.
A switching regulator or non-linear power topology is needed.
